title: Great app but…
body: You're doing a pretty good job developing this app, great UI design, and it's intuitive but sometimes there are many things on screen and I would like to have a minimalistic UI option
author: ed50100

title: No funciona los recordatorios
body: Podría ser excelente, se organiza todo pero sin recordatorios no sirve de nada,  por lo tanto mejor debería ser una APP pagada y no free, molesta tanto anuncio de la app pagada
